en: "Hail, $playerName. I'm $PersonRank $personName, your service record with the $theFaction Navy is impressive. I've heard some flattering nicknames for you. How can we assist?"
zh: 【向你致意，$playerName。我是$PersonRank $personName，你在$theFaction海军的服役记录令人印象深刻。我听过几个奉承你的绰号。我们能为你做点什么？】

en: "Transponder's recognized, $playerName. $theFaction has no quarrel with independent operators who've proven themselves reliable." Their eyes flick to a tactical display. "State your purpose."
zh: 【应答机已识别，$playerName。$theFaction与证明过自己可靠的独立经营者无冤无仇。】对方的目光扫过战术显示屏。【说明来意。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=OpenCommLink)

en: "This is $PersonRank $personName of $theFaction Navy. Your IFF reads neutral. That can change very quickly, Captain, so let's keep this brief and professional."
zh: 【这里是$PersonRank $personName，隶属$theFaction海军。你的敌我识别读数是中立。这可以变得非常快，舰长，所以让我们简短而专业地谈。】

en: "Who the fu - Who is - What - I should kick your fucking ass, who is this?" There is a brief silence, cut short by the frantic sound of typing. "Ah, $playerName! I've notified the Department of Internal Security of your presence, leave immediately. Athebyne's scars run deep enough without adding your name to the list."
zh: 【搞什——是谁——什么——我真该揍你一顿，这是谁？】短暂的沉默，被疯狂的键盘声打断。【啊，$playerName！我已把你的出现通报给内部安全部，立刻离开。Athebyne 的伤疤已经够深了，不想再添上你的名字。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextRejectHostile)

en:
"Loyalty's a rare commodity out here, and you're fresh out. We've got no room for dual allegiances."

"That said, if you're serious about joining, resign from $theOtherCommissionFaction. And we'll gladly put your skills to use in $theFaction."
zh:
【忠诚在这片星域是稀缺品，而你恰好缺货。我们这里不养怀有二心的人。】

【话虽如此，如果你真想加入，先辞去$theOtherCommissionFaction的雇佣协议。我们会乐意让你的一身本事为$theFaction所用。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextHasOther)

en: "I'm sorry, but you don't meet our criteria for receiving a commission. To put it plainly you're a wildcard, Commander. Shape up your outfit, purge the weak links, then come back. Until then, you're unfit for Draconis colors. However I've noted your request."
zh: 【抱歉，你不符合我们授予雇佣协议的标准。直说了吧，指挥官，你是个不定数。整顿好你的队伍，清掉薄弱环节，再来。在那之前，你配不上德拉科尼斯的旗帜。不过你的申请我记下了。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextUnsuited)

en:
"Hmm, yes, you're a suitable candidate. Admiral August will be pleased. We're always short on manpower."

"Accepting a commission is a serious matter, however. You will be required to fight enemies of $theFaction. You'll be able to resign your commission at any time, though I don't imagine doing so would win you any friends."
zh:
【嗯，是的，你是合适的人选。August 元帅会很高兴。我们一直缺人手。】

【不过，接受雇佣协议是件严肃的事。你将被要求与$theFaction的敌人作战。你随时可以辞去协议——尽管我不觉得那样做能给你赢得朋友。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextSuitedPart1)

en: "So, how about it? Still want to sign on?"
zh: 【那么，怎么样？还想签约吗？】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextSuitedPart2)

en: "Oath sworn. Welcome to the fold, Commander. Your IFF's updated - Draconis blue on your scope now."
zh: 【宣誓完毕。欢迎入伙，指挥官。你的敌我识别已更新——现在你的雷达上是德拉科尼斯蓝。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextWelcomePart1)

en: "Anything else I can do for you?"
zh: 【还有什么我能效劳的？】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextWelcomePart2)

en: "Cold feet already?" $personName raises an eyebrow. "The Sector's full of fence-sitters who think twice when the guns start barking. Fafnir's ghosts don't suffer the hesitant, neither do we. Application withdrawn. If you grow a spine, our doors aren't barred... Yet."
zh: 【这就怂了？】$personName挑起一边眉毛。【星域里到处是枪一响就犹豫的骑墙派。法夫纳的亡灵不收留迟疑者，我们也是。申请撤回。哪天你长出脊梁了，我们的门没上锁……暂时。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNTextChangeMind)

en: "Resign? After we stamped your papers and handed you the keys to our armory? Commander, that's not how the Alliance works." $personFirstName pauses their typing to face you. "$TheFaction needs anyone it can get, and turning your back on us won't be forgotten."
zh: 【辞职？在我们给你盖了章、把军械库钥匙交到你手上之后？指挥官，同盟不是这么办事的。】$personFirstName停下打字，转过身来。【$TheFaction需要一切能抓到手的人，而在我们背后转身这种事，不会被忘记。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNResignAskToConfirm)

en: $personFirstName sighs dramatically. "Fine. Resignation accepted, effective immediately. Your IFF's wiped, access codes revoked."
zh: $personFirstName夸张地叹了口气。【行。辞呈接受，即刻生效。你的敌我识别已抹除，访问权限已吊销。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNResignConfirmed)

en: "Wise choice, Lieutenant. Knew you had the spine for it. Oath renewed - no hard feelings, just hard lessons."
zh: 【明智的选择，中尉。就知道你有这个脊梁。宣誓续期——不留芥蒂，只留教训。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=CMSNResignCancelled)

en: Fleet Admiral August has personally recognized your contributions to the Alliance. Joint Command has extended full access to military stockpiles and forward operating bases, and even the most security-conscious AIO liaison officers no longer shadow your movements. Alliance Citizens across Fafnir regard you as one of their own - a rare distinction for anyone who didn't endure the Reunification.
zh: August 舰队元帅亲自认可了你对同盟的贡献。联合司令部向你开放了军用储备与前沿作战基地的完全访问权限，连警惕性最强的 AIO 联络官也不再跟踪你的行踪。法夫纳各地的同盟公民视你为自己人——对没经历过再统一的人来说，这是罕见的殊荣。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: Alliance officials have come to regard you as a reliable partner rather than a convenient asset. Port authorities process your docking requests without the usual security theater, and patrol captains are more likely to offer assistance than demand transponder logs. The gratitude of Joint Command translates to meaningful access to military-grade hardware.
zh: 同盟官员已把你当作可靠的伙伴，而非顺手的工具。港务部门处理你的入港申请时省去了惯常的安全表演，巡逻舰长更可能提供协助而非索要应答机日志。联合司令部的谢意，转化为对军规级硬件的实际获取渠道。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: Your reputation has reached the attention of mid-level Alliance commanders, several of whom have noted your reliability in official dispatches. System patrols treat your $shipOrFleet as a known quantity rather than a potential threat, and port authorities extend courtesies typically reserved for Alliance-flagged vessels.
zh: 你的名声已经传到同盟中层指挥官的耳中，其中几位在官方急件里记下了你的可靠。星系巡逻队把你的$shipOrFleet当作已知量而非潜在威胁，港务部门给予你通常只留给同盟旗舰船的礼遇。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: Alliance commanders have begun to take note of your activities - favorably, if cautiously. In practice, this means access to surplus military equipment and fewer pointed questions from patrol captains. The institutional paranoia born from the civil war hasn't faded entirely, but you've earned the benefit of the doubt.
zh: 同盟指挥官开始留意你的活动——态度是审慎的好评。实际来说，这意味着你能获取富余的军用装备，巡逻舰长的尖锐提问也少了些。内战留下的制度性疑惧尚未散尽，但你已经赢得了【姑且相信】。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: To Alliance officials, you're simply another independent operator - neither a threat nor an asset worth cultivating. This is, by local standards, a reasonable position to occupy. The DDA's history has left its leadership wary of outsiders, but not hostile without cause.
zh: 在同盟官员眼里，你只是又一个独立经营者——既非威胁，也非值得栽培的资产。按本地标准，这是个合理的处境。DDA 的历史让它的领导层对外人保持警惕，但不会无端敌对。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: Something in your record has drawn scrutiny from Alliance security. Port authorities process your requests with deliberate slowness, and patrol commanders run your transponder against watchlists more often than strictly necessary. You're not unwelcome, but you're certainly not trusted.
zh: 你记录里的某些东西招来了同盟安全部门的审视。港务部门处理你的申请时刻意放慢，巡逻指挥官核对你的应答机与观察名单的频率也远超必要。你不是不受欢迎，但也绝不是受信任。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: Joint Command has flagged your $shipOrFleet as a potential security concern. Port officials find reasons to deny docking requests, and patrol captains interpret their rules of engagement generously when your drives light up on their scopes. The Alliance hasn't declared you an enemy - but they've stopped pretending you might be a friend.
zh: 联合司令部已将你的$shipOrFleet标记为潜在安全隐患。港口官员总能找到拒绝你入港申请的理由，而当你的引擎在他们的雷达上亮起时，巡逻舰长对交战规则的理解会变得相当宽松。同盟没有宣布你为敌人——但他们已不再假装你可能是朋友。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: Alliance patrols are authorized to engage your $shipOrFleet on sight. Markets under DDA control deny you access, and any incident involving your vessels is treated as confirmation of hostile intent. Whatever goodwill you might have once possessed has been thoroughly exhausted.
zh: 同盟巡逻队已获准对你的$shipOrFleet见即开火。DDA 控制下的市场对你关闭，任何涉及你舰船的事件都被视作敌意企图的实证。你或许曾拥有过的一点好感，已被彻底耗尽。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: The Alliance has classified you as an active threat to sector stability. Your name circulates in Joint Command briefings alongside pirates, warlords, and other enemies of the fragile peace August built from the ashes of civil war. No patrol captain will hesitate to add your $shipOrFleet to the long list of threats the DDA has ground to dust.
zh: 同盟已将你归类为星域稳定的现实威胁。你的名字在联合司令部的简报里与海盗、军阀以及 August 从内战灰烬上建立的脆弱和平的其他敌人并列传阅。任何巡逻舰长都会毫不犹豫地把你的$shipOrFleet加入 DDA 碾成粉末的那份长长的威胁名单。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: Joint Command regards your $shipOrFleet as one more hostile element in a sector that produces them endlessly. Alliance captains have standing orders to engage and destroy - the same orders they've executed against countless threats since the Reunification. You are not special. You are simply next.
zh: 联合司令部将你的$shipOrFleet视为这片无尽产出敌对元素的星域里再多一个敌对元素。同盟舰长持有接敌即歼的常备命令——与再统一以来他们对无数威胁执行过的命令相同。你并不特别。你只是下一个。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: The Alliance views your growing power as an existential threat to everything the Reunification preserved. Somewhere in Joint Command, planners are assembling a task force with your colonies marked for pacification. The DDA has survived civil war, corporate predation, and worse. They do not intend to let you succeed where those threats failed.
zh: 同盟视你不断增长的势力为对再统一所保存的一切的现实威胁。联合司令部的某个角落，参谋们正在组建一支特遣舰队，你的殖民地已被标记为待平定目标。DDA 从内战、企业掠食和更糟的东西里活了下来。他们不打算放任你在那些威胁失败的地方得手。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=RelationshipLevelDesc)

en: "We're prepared to pay well for these - better than you'd get selling them quietly elsewhere, and without the legal complications. The Alliance has legitimate research applications for recovered cores. What Hegemony inspectors don't know won't trouble them, or you."
zh: 【我们愿意出高价收购——比你在别处悄悄出手划算，还没有法律纠纷。同盟对回收的核心有正当的研究用途。霸主督察不知道的事，就不会烦到他们，也不会烦到你。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=DialogOptionSelected)

en: You transmit the comms ID and wait for the system to establish a connection. However, the comms link establishes after a longer delay than typical military protocols demand. When the image resolves, it's deliberately degraded - encryption artifacts dance across a humanoid silhouette, facial features reduced to suggestions of shadow and light.
zh: 你发送通讯识别码，等待系统建立连接。然而，通讯链路建立的延迟远超一般军事规程所需。图像解析出来时是刻意劣化的——加密噪点在一具人形轮廓上跳动，五官化约为光影的暗示。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=OpenCDE)

en:
"Captain." The voice carries the flat authority of someone accustomed to being obeyed. "Your reputation precedes you, but reputation alone doesn't grant clearance for what we discuss here."

A pause. You sense him consulting something off-screen.

"If you're serious about serving the Draconis Defence Alliance, our diplomatic corps can arrange a commission. Standard channels. Until then..." The distorted figure makes a gesture that might be dismissive, might be regretful. "I'm afraid we have nothing further to discuss."

The link cuts before you can respond.
zh:
【舰长。】那声音带着一种习惯了被服从的平板威严。【你的名声先你一步，但名声本身换不来我们在这里讨论之事的许可。】

一段停顿。你察觉他在查看屏幕外的什么东西。

【如果你真心想为德拉科尼斯防卫同盟效力，我们的外交团可以安排一份雇佣协议。走标准渠道。在那之前……】失真的身影做了个手势，可能是敷衍，也可能是遗憾。【恐怕我们没什么可谈的了。】

链路在你回应之前被切断。

en:
"Commander $playerLastName." The distorted visage tilts slightly, as if examining you through the compression grain. What might be satisfaction colors the modulated voice. "We've been watching your work." A beat. "Impressed, I should say."

He leans forward slightly, the motion causing the encryption to ripple and distort. "The Draconis Defence Alliance rewards competence. More importantly, we recognize when someone possesses the tactical acumen we need for what's coming."

Your command console chimes softly - an incoming data packet, heavily encrypted.
zh:
【$playerLastName 指挥官。】失真的面容微微偏侧，仿佛在透过压缩颗粒审视你。那经过调制的声音里透出某种可能是满意的东西。【我们一直在看你的工作。】一拍。【应该说，印象颇深。】

他微微前倾，动作让加密画面荡起涟漪。【德拉科尼斯防卫同盟奖赏能力。更重要的是，我们看得出谁拥有我们在将至之事中需要的战术头脑。】

你的指挥控制台轻响一声——一个数据包正在传入，带着重重加密。

en:
"There is." A measured pause. "I'm authorized to offer you something off the books," he continues. "The XLII's specialized vessels. Bleeding edge. Ships that aren't in any public registry, that most admirals don't even know exist." His fingers tap something you can't see. "Ships that could turn the tide when it matters most."

A calculated pause. The kind that precedes uncomfortable truths.

"There's a nominal fee - twice their usual cost and an adjustment to your standing with us. Administrative necessity. Insurance that you understand the value of what we're offering." The ghost of a smile in his voice. "But the tactical advantage? The capability these hulls represent?" Another pause, heavier this time. "That's worth considerably more than any credit transfer, Commander."
zh:

一段精心计算的停顿。那种先于不快真相而至的停顿。

【有一笔象征性费用——双倍于常规售价，外加调整你在我方的声望。行政需要。确保你理解我们提供之物价值的保险。】他声音里浮起一丝笑意。【但战术优势呢？这些舰体所代表的能力？】又一停顿，这次更沉。【那可比任何信用点转账值钱得多，指挥官。】

en:
"I remember a raid on Athebyne's supply depots, some cycles ago. We were running low on everything - fuel, munitions, pilots. Lieutenant Reyes - solid flyer, came up through the reserves - took a squadron of Grumiums on what should've been a suicide run. Six wings, loaded heavy, against fortified emplacements and interceptor screens."

"Lumbered in like cargo haulers. Reyes lost half his wing before they even lined up the shot. But the ones that made it through? Dropped their payload right into the heart of the depot. Chain reactions lit up the night side of the planet. We got the resupply we needed to hold the line another month."

"Reyes brought three back. Got a commendation posthumously - caught a missile on the egress. The Grumium's no hero's ride. Slow, ugly work. But if it kills, it serves. And sometimes, that's all you need."

A brief pause as the transfer finalizes.

"Commander."
zh:
【我记得几个周期前对 Athebyne 补给库的一次突袭。我们什么都快见底了——燃料、弹药、飞行员。Reyes 少尉——扎实的飞行员，预备役出身——带了一个中队的天棒一去执行一趟本该是自杀的任务。六个联队，满载，对面是加固阵地和拦截机屏障。】

【像货船一样笨拙地挪进去。Reyes 的中队还没摆好射角就折损了一半。但冲过去的那几架？把载荷正正丢进了补给库的心脏。连锁反应点亮了行星的夜面。我们拿到了再坚守一个月所需的补给。】

【Reyes 带回来三架。追授了一枚嘉奖——撤离时挨了一枚导弹。天棒一不是英雄的座驾。又慢又丑的活儿。但只要它能杀敌，它就有用。有时候，这就够了。】

en:
"Most people look at her now and see a relic - ill fit for modern combat. But I remember when she was all we had.

Third week of the siege at Athebyne orbital. My flagship had taken a reactor hit, and I transferred my flag to the Resolute - an Alruba. We had six of them left in the picket line, facing down twice our number.

The captain - Walker, good officer - kept us between the troop transports and their missile boats. Took hits that would've gutted a Thuban. The armour held. Barely. By the time relief arrived, we'd lost three Alrubas, but the transports made it through.

Walker didn't. Reactor breach on the final push.

The Alruba's not fast. Not elegant. But she's honest. And doesn't quit until she's a debris field. Sometimes that's enough."

A brief pause as the data finalizes.

"That'll be all, Commander."
zh:
【大多数人现在看她，看到的是一件遗物——与现代格斗格格不入。但我记得她就是我们全部家当的时候。

Athebyne 轨道围城战的第三周。我的旗舰反应堆中弹，我把将旗移到了坚定号——一艘驹。警戒线上我们只剩六艘，对面是两倍于我们的数量。

舰长——Walker，好军官——让我们的船保持在运兵船与敌导弹艇之间。挨的打足以开膛一艘右枢。装甲顶住了。勉强。援军抵达时，我们折了三艘驹，但运兵船全部突围。

Walker 没有。最后冲锋时反应堆破裂。

驹不快。不优雅。但她实在。不当成碎片场绝不罢休。有时候这就够了。】

en:
"The Shaobi. The Marines' favourite toy. Command didn't want to build her - too specialised, too expensive. But the Marines made their case, and somehow, it stuck.

I'll admit, I didn't see the value. Not at first.

Then came the boarding operation at Ring-Port - back when it was still under separatist control. We needed to take the station intact, and orbital bombardment wasn't an option. That meant Marines. Lots of them.

The Shaobi-class Warhound led the assault. Two hundred Marines, full combat load, deployed in under twenty minutes. They hit three docking points simultaneously - precision insertion, no warning.

The captain - Major Hartley, Marine Corps - she coordinated the whole thing from the Warhound's bridge. Ship-to-boarding-craft comms, real-time tactical updates, fire support from the gunship's turrets. It wasn't just a carrier - it was a forward command post with engines.

We took Ring-Port in six hours. Minimal casualties. Hartley got a medal. The Warhound got a reputation.

The Shaobi's not a fleet carrier. She's not meant to be. But if you need boots on a station or a hostile ship, she'll get them there - and bring them home.

Sometimes that's worth more than another fighter wing."

A pause.

"The Alliance chose well with you, Commander. Transfer authorized."
zh:
【少弼。陆战队的心头好。司令部本不想造她——太专精，太贵。但陆战队把理由摆了出来，不知怎么，就成了。

我承认，起初我没看出价值。

然后是环港的跳帮行动——那会儿它还在分裂分子手里。我们需要完整拿下空间站，轨道轰炸不在选项里。那意味着陆战队。大量的陆战队。

少弼级战犬号领衔主攻。两百名陆战队员，全副武装，二十分钟内部署完毕。他们同时突入三个对接点——精确渗透，毫无预警。

舰长——Hartley 少校，陆战队——在战犬号的舰桥上协调整场行动。舰对突击艇通讯、实时战术更新、炮艇炮塔的火力支援。她不只是航母——是一座装了引擎的前沿指挥所。

我们六小时拿下环港。伤亡极小。Hartley 拿了勋章。战犬号拿了名声。

少弼不是舰队航母。她也无意如此。但当你需要把军靴踩上空间站或敌舰时，她能把人送到——再把人带回来。

有时候这比多一支战机联队更值钱。】

一拍停顿。

【同盟选你选得不错，指挥官。转账已批准。】

en:
"A carrier escort strictly speaking. Compromised sensors to save weight and meet project requirements. Command signed off on it because she was never meant to operate independently.

That became a problem during the push on Athebyne's outer stations. We had the Milwaukee - assigned to screen the Io's carrier group. Standard formation, textbook deployment. Then the carrier's sensor array took a hit from long-range fire. Partial failure - enough to briefly shunt the datalink, not enough to justify pulling back.

The Milwaukee was supposed to provide missile support. But with the carrier's sensors degraded and her own array already limited, she couldn't get a clean firing solution on anything beyond visual range. Captain Holt - had a ship full of ordnance and nothing to shoot at.

So he did what the ship wasn't designed to do: he moved in close. Uncomfortably close.

The Milwaukee took more hits in that engagement than any other ship in the group. Lost two crew compartments, vented half her missile reserves in an ammunition cook off. But the carrier stayed operational, and the screen held."

Your sensors officer glances back at you, eyebrows raised. Authorization codes transmitted.

"Until next time, Commander."
zh:
【严格说是航母护卫舰。传感器缩水减重，为的是满足项目指标。司令部签了字，因为她从来就没打算独立作战。

这在对 Athebyne 外围站的推进中成了问题。密尔沃基号在我们手里——分配去掩护 Io 号的航母群。标准阵形，教科书式部署。然后航母的传感器阵列挨了一记远弹。部分失效——足以让数据链短暂断流，又不值得就此撤退。

密尔沃基号本该提供导弹支援。但航母传感器降级，她自己的阵列又天生短视，视距之外她拿不到干净的射击解算。Holt 舰长——满船弹药，无事可打。

于是他干了这船没被设计去干的事：他贴了上去。近得不舒服的那种。

那场交战里密尔沃基号挨的弹比群里任何一艘都多。丢了两间舰员舱，弹药殉爆排掉了半数导弹储备。但航母保住了运转，警戒线守住了。】

你的传感器军官回头看你一眼，眉毛挑起。授权码已发送。

【下次见，指挥官。】

en:
"Even while it serves it's considered a 'prototype'. Armoured like a battleship, just fast enough to keep up with cruiser squadrons. On paper, she's perfect. In practice? A damned miracle - when she works.

At end of the war had four Juzas in active service. The Jericho was flagship for the third battle group - my XO's command. Fleet engagement near Athebyne's inner belt. Standard line battle, cruiser-on-cruiser.

Then the Jericho's flux regulators spiked. Total system failure - her shields dropped, her weapons went cold. A paperweight in the middle of a firing line.

Her chief engineer - man named Nowak, stubborn bastard - he rerouted power through the secondary grid, bypassed the safeties, and brought the flux system back online in under three minutes. A miracle to put it bluntly.

By the time the Jericho came back, she'd taken fourteen direct hits. Her armour held. Barely. Nowak kept her running for another six hours before the system burned out for good. We won that engagement.

The Juza's temperamental. High-maintenance. But if you've got a crew that knows her quirks, she'll hold the line when everything else breaks."

A brief silence followed by an authorization code transmission.

"Authorization granted."
zh:
【哪怕在服役中她也被当作‘原型’。装甲厚得像战列舰，速度刚好跟得上巡洋舰中队。纸面上她完美。实际呢？一个不折不扣的奇迹——在她肯干活的时候。

战争结束时我们有四艘主宰在役。耶利哥号是第三战斗群的旗舰——我副手的座舰。Athebyne 内环带附近的舰队交战。标准线列战，巡洋舰对巡洋舰。

然后耶利哥号的幅能调节器炸了。系统全面故障——护盾跌落，武器冷膛。火力线正中央的一块镇纸。

她的轮机长——叫 Nowak 的男人，倔得要死——把功率改走次级电网，绕过保险，三分钟内让幅能系统重新上线。直说了吧，一个奇迹。

等耶利哥号缓过来时，她已经挨了十四发直击。装甲顶住了。勉强。Nowak 让她又跑了六个小时，系统才彻底烧毁。那场仗我们赢了。

主宰娇气。保养昂贵。但只要你有一班懂她脾气的舰员，在天塌下来的时候，她会守住战线。】

一小段沉默，随后是授权码的发送。

【授权完毕。】

en:
"I've heard the jokes - "by the time she arrives, the war's over." The crews call her the 'Late Arrival.'

An anecdote: Textbook carrier doctrine. Three battlegroups were to warp directly into the fight. The Alwaid's group? Delayed by a drive malfunction - forty minutes late to the fight.

By the time they arrived, we'd lost Heaven's Axiom and half her escort. The Diligence was burning, venting atmosphere from six hull breaches. We were fifteen minutes from a full retreat.

Then the Eternity translated in-system. Two hundred and sixty fighters. Every torpedo tube loaded. She didn't win the battle herself - but she ended it. The enemy scattered. We held the orbitals.

The Alwaid's slow. But when she gets there, she brings everything."

The faintest pause.

"It's yours."
zh:
【笑话我听过——‘等她赶到，仗都打完了。’舰员们叫她‘迟到者’。

一则轶事：教科书式的航母教义。三个战斗群要直接跃入战场。龙首的群呢？驱动器故障耽搁了——比开打晚了四十分钟。

等他们到的时候，我们已经折了天堂公理号和半数护卫。勤勉号在燃烧，从六个舰体破口漏着大气。我们距离全线撤退还有十五分钟。

然后永恒号跃入星系。两百六十架战机。每一根鱼雷管都满载。她没有独自赢下那场仗——但她终结了它。敌军溃散。我们守住了轨道。

龙首慢。但她抵达时，带来的是全部。】

【她是你的了。】

en:
"Four cycles ago, a Pather raiding flotilla entered Kori's orbital space in coordination with a surface sabotage operation. The intent was to occupy our response force long enough for the ground teams to finish their work. The Covenant was in the patrol rotation.

Vasile, her commander, took her through the centre of the formation. Struck their lead ship at speed, engaged the second at close range, and repositioned between the flotilla and their egress vector before their command element had processed what had happened. The aft section took heavy damage. Prioritised forward coverage with the rear mount. But even so, the flotilla broke. The surface teams lost their extraction window.

The after-action report was four pages. Three and a half of them were just damage assessments. The remaining half-page described his tactical reasoning in language I found adequate but incomplete. He did not mention that the Covenant's approach vector was inconsistent with any evasive option - that closing at that speed, on that bearing, was not a response to the engagement. It was a conclusion he had reached before the engagement began.

He is a precise man. His logs are immaculate. I do not think the imprecision was accidental."

A silence. Although not long.

"Take good care of her, Commander. The Alliance has few enough of these."
zh:
【四个周期前，一支左径袭掠船队进入 Kori 轨道空域，配合一次地面破坏行动。意图是拖住我们的反应部队，给地面小组争取完工时间。圣约号正在巡逻轮值。

她的指挥官 Vasile 带着她直插编队中心。高速撞上其领舰，近距接敌第二艘，然后在敌方指挥层反应过来之前，重新卡位到船队与其撤退向量之间。舰尾重创。他把尾炮火力优先调向正面覆盖。即便如此，船队溃散了。地面小组失去了撤离窗口。

战后报告四页。三页半都是损伤评估。剩下半页描述他的战术推理，措辞我认为充分但不完整。他没有提到圣约号的接近向量与任何规避选项都不一致——以那个速度、那个方位逼近，不是对交战的应对。那是他在交战开始之前就已得出的结论。

他是个精确的人。他的日志一尘不染。我不认为那处不精确是偶然。】

一阵沉默。不算长。

【好好待她，指挥官。同盟的这种船不多了。】

Hazard stripes still clings stubbornly to the hull plating beneath layers of micrometeorite scarring and weapons burns.

【这里还有更多碎片。调往 Kori 的转移令、人员名单。允许提取整个缓存吗？】

"Cycle 47 pre-Alliance. Auth: Capt. Emil August, forwarded through Corps Command."

"'All Signal Corps detachments are hereby detached from line-of-battle duties and assigned to permanent perimeter security and monitoring of Fafnir Gate structure. Primary objective: detect and report any unauthorized hyperspace transit attempt. Secondary objective: prevent physical access by non-cleared personnel.

This assignment is non-negotiable. Resources will be reallocated accordingly.

Endorsement appended by Lt. Cmdr. J. Halvorsen, Signal Corps:

"Understood the strategic logic on paper. Still feels like punishment duty. We're bleeding hull plating at Athebyne's Lagrange points while half the corps sits on cold alloy watching a ring that hasn't twitched since the Collapse. August must know something we don't. Or he's finally lost it."'
zh:
【同盟前第47周期。授权人：Emil August 上校，经军团司令部转发。】

【‘所有信号军团分队即日起脱离战列职责，转任 Fafnir 星门建筑的永久外围警戒与监视。首要目标：侦测并上报任何未授权的超空间跃迁企图。次要目标：阻止未获许可人员接近。】

【本指派不容商量。资源将相应重新调配。】

信号军团 J. Halvorsen 少校附注：

【纸面上的战略逻辑我懂。可这感觉就是发配。我们在 Athebyne 的拉格朗日点上流血掉装甲，半个军团却坐在冷合金上盯着一座大崩坏之后就没动过一下的环。August 肯定知道些我们不知道的事。要么他终于疯了。】

en:
"Cycle 49 pre-Alliance. Auth: Lt. Mara Velas, Field Engineering Lead."

"'Attempt 47 concluded 03:14 shipboard. Full power shunt through primary manifold coupling. Ring returned to quiescent state within 0.8 seconds. No aperture formation, no phase excursion, no manifold breach.

Same result as Attempt 46. And 45. And every attempt back to 12.

However: return signal consistent across all attempts. Three discrete hyperwave pulses, 1.7-second spacing, identical modulation envelope. Subcarrier contains structured data we cannot yet parse. It responds to our probe strength - louder input yields louder reply.

It is not an echo. It is a handshake.

Recommendation: cease active attempts until we can fabricate better decoding hardware. Morale note: crew has started calling the anomaly 'the patient one.' Not sure I like the nickname.'"
zh:
【同盟前第49周期。授权人：Mara Velas 中尉，野外工程主管。】

【‘第47次尝试于舰载时 03:14 结束。全功率经主导管耦合器分流。环体在 0.8 秒内回归静默态。无孔径形成，无相位偏移，无导管破裂。】

【与第46次尝试结果相同。第45次也是。一直数到第12次，全都一样。】

【然而：所有尝试的回波信号完全一致。三个离散超波脉冲，间隔 1.7 秒，调制包络相同。子载波含有我们尚无法解析的结构化数据。它会回应我们的探测强度——输入越响，回应越响。】

【那不是回声。那是握手。】

【建议：在造出更好的解码硬件之前停止主动尝试。士气记录：舰员们开始管那个异常叫‘有耐心的那位’。我不确定我喜欢这个绰号。’】

"Cycle 51 pre-Alliance. Auth: Adm. Emil August, countersigned AIO precursor cell."

"'Effective immediately: all Signal Corps assets under designation 'Gatewatch' are to cease operations at Fafnir Gate and redeploy subsurface, Kori primary grid, reference Alpha-7 / Theta-9.

New primary objective: secure, stabilize, and establish interface protocols with Domain-era megastructure; codeword designation: [OCTANTIS].

All previous Gate monitoring logs are to be archived under maximum encryption and physically transferred to Kori vault. No further active interrogation of the Gate permitted. Demolition charges remain on standby per prior order.

Personal addendum, August: "The answers are under Kori. That is where the war will be decided now."'
zh:
【同盟前第51周期。授权人：Emil August 中将，AIO 前身小组副署。】

【‘即刻起：所有隶属‘守门哨’编制的信号军团资产停止在 Fafnir 星门的作业，转入 Kori 主网格地下，参照点 Alpha-7 / Theta-9。】

【新首要目标：封存、稳化域国时代巨构，并与之建立接口协议；代号：[OCTANTIS]。】

【此前所有星门监视日志以最高加密归档，实体转移至 Kori 地库。不得再对星门进行主动探询。爆破装药按先前命令保持待命。】

August 个人附言：【答案在 Kori 之下。战争的胜负，如今要在那里决定。】

en:
"Cycle 52 pre-Alliance. Auth: precursor cell, later designated Alliance Intelligence Office."

"'Signal Corps detachment Gatewatch formally stood down. Surviving personnel and technical assets folded into new standing formation: Alliance Intelligence Section (provisional) under Rear Admiral S. Surher's oversight.

Mission parameters redefined: - Acquisition, integration, and operational employment of [OCTANTIS]-derived computational systems. - Evaluation and controlled implementation of AI-core augmentation protocols previously prohibited under Sector norms. - Protection of all related programs from external compromise (Hegemony, Persean League, Tri-Tachyon, Luddic elements). - Elimination or reorientation of personnel who represent unacceptable risk to operational security.

From this cycle forward, the Section answers only to unified command authority. Taboos are suspended for the duration of the emergency - which is now declared permanent.

Final line, unsigned but cipher-matched to August: "You are no longer watchers. You are keepers. And you shall keep what must never be loosed upon the Sector... or what must be loosed only by our hand."'

They tap the console once more, locking the slate.

"Whatever [OCTANTIS] actually is... it didn't come through the Gate. It was already here. And it's been talking to them."

A beat of silence on the bridge.

"Orders, Captain?"
zh:
【同盟前第52周期。授权人：前身小组，后定名同盟情报局。】

【‘信号军团守门哨分队正式解散。幸存人员与技术资产并入新常设编制：同盟情报科（临时），由 S. Surher 海军少将督导。】

【任务参数重新定义：——获取、整合并作战运用 [OCTANTIS] 衍生的计算系统。——评估并受控实施此前为星域规范所禁止的 AI 核心强化协议。——保护所有相关计划免遭外部渗透（霸主、英仙座联盟、速子科技、卢德各派）。——清除或转向对行动安全构成不可接受风险的人员。】

【自本周期起，情报科只对统一指挥当局负责。禁忌在紧急状态期间暂停——而紧急状态现已宣告为永久。】

最后一行，未署名但密码匹配指向 August：【你们不再是守望者。你们是守藏者。你们要守住的，是绝不可放归星域之物……或者，只可由我们之手放出之物。】

他们再次敲了一下控制台，锁上板岩。

【不管 [OCTANTIS] 到底是什么……它不是从星门来的。它早就在这儿了。而且一直在和他们交谈。】

舰桥上一拍寂静。

【命令，舰长？】

The encryption holds. He doesn't move.

"The Gate was a receiver. A way of asking whether something was listening. Once we understood that, continuing at the Gate was redundant. The conversation had already moved."

【因为星门从来不是源头。】一停。【我们凿开 Kori 表面的那一刻，脉冲就停了。无论回应我们的是什么——它不是从星门来的。它早就在这儿。】

加密画面纹丝不动。他没有动。

"I gave them a mandate and they filled it." His tone lays flat. No defensiveness. "Counterintelligence. Then signals. Then guarding Kori. Each expansion seemed reasonable at the time, inside the emergency we were managing."

A brief silence.

"By the time I understood what they'd become, reversing it would have required options I no longer had. The Office knows too much. The Office does too much. And the Alliance depends on both." He pauses. "Some blindspots are chosen, Commander. You'll learn that if you haven't already."
zh:
【我给了他们一份授权，他们把它填满了。】他的语气平铺直叙。没有辩解。【反情报。然后是信号。然后是守卫 Kori。在当时、在我们应对的紧急状态之内，每一次扩张都显得合理。】

一阵短暂的沉默。

【等我明白他们变成了什么，逆转它所需要的选项已经不在手上。情报局知道得太多。情报局做得太多。而同盟两者都依赖。】他停顿。【有些盲点是选出来的，指挥官。如果你还没学到，早晚会的。】

"Our key to survival." A pause. "That's what I told myself."

He shifts. The encryption distorts around the motion.

"A Domain-era computational device. Designated OCTANTIS. Built to coordinate colonial infrastructure across multiple systems - resource allocation, logistics, production planning. Never finished. Sealed when the Collapse severed its purpose."

He is quiet for a moment.

"Then the Office woke it." Another pause, heavier. "And that's where the fog of war begins. I know the outline. The Office knows the rest."
zh:
【我们活下去的钥匙。】一停。【这是我说服自己的说法。】

他动了动。加密画面随动作扭曲。

【一台域国时代的计算装置。代号 OCTANTIS。为跨星系统筹殖民地基建而造——资源分配、物流、生产规划。从未完工。大崩坏切断它的使命时，它被封存。】

他安静了片刻。

【然后情报局唤醒了它。】又一停，更沉。【战争的迷雾从这里开始。我知道轮廓。其余的，情报局知道。】

en:
The line is quiet for a moment. Longer than it needs to be.

"You've heard more than most, Commander." His voice is measured and deliberate. "Let me ask you something in return."

A pause.

"Given everything you know - the Gate, Kori, the Office, what was necessary to keep this system alive - what would you have done in my position?"
zh:
线路安静了片刻。比需要的更长。

【你听到的已经比大多数人多了，指挥官。】他的声音审慎而刻意。【让我反过来问你一个问题。】

一停。

【基于你知道的一切——星门、Kori、情报局、维系这个星系所必需的一切——换作你在我的位置，你会怎么做？】

en:
"I'm so surrounded by yes-men that it is hard to believe it, but given the benefit of doubt."

He is still for a moment.

"Good..." The word lands without inflection. "That's the correct answer, and the honest one."

A pause.

"Survival doesn't come with clean choices. Anyone who tells you otherwise has never been responsible for something that cannot be allowed to fail."

"I'm glad we understand each other."
zh:
【我身边全是应声虫，很难相信这种话，但我姑且信你。】

他静了一瞬。

【很好……】这个词落地时没有起伏。【那是正确的答案，也是诚实的答案。】

一停。

【生存从不附带干净的选项。告诉你相反说法的人，从来没为一件不容失败的东西负过责。】

【我很高兴我们彼此理解。】

"Yes." He doesn't dismiss it. "You might have."

A pause.

"I've had that thought myself. In the years after Kori went active - what might we have learned, if we'd moved more slowly. If we'd been less desperate."

The encrypted silhouette is still.

"But the war didn't give us time for philosophy, Commander. It rarely does. We understood enough to survive. I'm not certain understanding more would have made us safer."
zh:
【是啊。】他没有敷衍。【你也许真的会。】

一停。

【我自己也这么想过。在 Kori 启动后的那些年——如果我们走得更慢，如果我们不那么绝望，我们本可以学到什么。】

加密的剪影一动不动。

【但战争没给我们留出哲学的时间，指挥官。它很少留。我们懂得够活下来就够了。我不确定懂得更多会让我们更安全。】

en:
"Neither would I." The voice is dry. "In principle. The problem with principle is that it requires you to identify the line before you've crossed it."

A pause.

"The Office was useful. Then it was necessary. Then it was irreplaceable. Each transition seemed logical at the time. The war makes everything seem logical." He is quiet for a moment. "If you find a way to draw that line clearly, Commander, let me know. I've been looking for it for thirty years."
zh:
【我也不会。】声音干涩。【原则上。原则的问题在于，它要求你先划出那条线，然后才越过去。】

一停。

【情报局曾经有用。然后变得必要。然后变得无可替代。每次过渡在当时都显得合乎逻辑。战争让一切都显得合乎逻辑。】他安静了片刻。【如果你找到清晰划出那条线的办法，指挥官，请告诉我。我找了三十年。】

Brief. Unguarded. He doesn't appear to have expected it any more than you did.

A pause.

The silence that follows is almost thoughtful.

"...Right."

短促。毫无防备。他看起来并不比你还预料到这一刻。

随之而来的沉默几乎是若有所思的。

【……好吧。】

他若无其事地继续说下去。

en:
"Good." A pause. "That's a more honest answer than most."

He is quiet.

"Neither did I, at the time. That's the truth of it. The Gate responded, and we followed the thread because we were losing and we needed anything we could use. And we accepted it because the alternative was starvation and slow defeat." The encrypted silhouette is still. "I made decisions under uncertainty and they kept the Alliance alive. I don't know if they were right. But I know they were necessary."

A brief pause.

"That distinction gets heavier every year."
zh:
【很好。】一停。【这比大多数答案都诚实。】

他安静着。

【当时我也不知道。事情就是这样。星门回应了，我们顺着线头走，因为我们正在输，需要一切用得上的东西。我们接受了它，因为另一种选择是饿死和缓慢的失败。】加密的剪影一动不动。【我在不确定中做的决定，让同盟活了下来。我不知道它们是否正确。但我知道它们是必要的。】

短暂一停。

【这个区别一年比一年更沉。】

en:
'You received the note?" He follows up before you can answer. "Good. Apologies for the secrecy - this operation is too important to risk on sloppiness."

"I've been told to brief you on our operation, so to cut it short - the Fleet Admiral sent me to prepare the station for a change of hands. The operational specifics are recent."

"August wants Ring-Port back, but not via our usual channels. And until now we haven't been able to commit Alliance assets without AIO oversight, and the Office's involvement would mean documentation, a review and secure process, and a multi-cycle delay while the Office investigates every nook and cranny of this facility before they even considered a direct assault." A pause. "You are not subject to that oversight."
zh:
【你收到纸条了？】他不等你回答就接了下去。【很好。抱歉搞得这么隐秘——这次行动太重要，不能败在马虎上。】

【上头要我向你简报行动，长话短说——舰队元帅派我来为这座空间站的易手做准备。作战细节是最近才定的。】

【August 想拿回环港，但不能走我们的常规渠道。而到现在为止，没有 AIO 监督我们就无法动用同盟资产，情报局一旦介入，就意味着文档、评审与安全流程，意味着长达数个周期的延误——情报局会把这座设施的每个犄角旮旯都查个遍，然后才会考虑直接突击。】一停。【你不受那种监督。】

en:
"Two main reasons, firstly, the logistical output of Ring-Port is not insignificant, and we need all the help we can get. Secondly, it's a matter of optics; we may be a small fish in a large pond, but this reflects poorly on the Alliance for not being able to take back such an important asset. Those are the official reasons, anyway; in reality, we need the free operating space to work without oversight. August has been assembling a contingent of those loyal to him and wants to seize control of the Office."

"The plan is straightforward. When the station changes hands, the AIO will arrive quickly after. That is expected. But our people are already embedded here - dock workers, transit staff, maintenance contractors, the list goes on - but the important detail is we've already prepared and secured this station before the AIO can sterilise it. If Alliance personnel hold the facility before the Office arrives, they hold it on the Admiral's terms."

A moment's pause as Korrin leans back, as he takes a moment for himself.

"The timing was mine to judge. I sent the signal when the station's current commander was between reliable subordinates. This window is narrow."
zh:
【两个主要原因。其一，环港的物流产出并非小数，我们需要一切能得到的助力。其二，是观感问题；我们也许是大池塘里的小鱼，但拿不回这么重要的资产，让同盟脸上无光。反正官方理由就是这些；实际上，我们需要一个不受监督的自由行动空间。August 一直在集结忠于他的人手，想夺取情报局的控制权。】

【计划很直接。空间站易手时，AIO 会很快赶到。这是预料之中的。但我们的人早就嵌进来了——码头工、转运员、维护承包商，名单还长——关键在于，赶在 AIO 对它进行清洗消毒之前，我们已经备好并控制了这座站。如果同盟人员在情报局抵达之前占住设施，他们就是按元帅的条件占住它。】

Korrin 后仰，为自己留了片刻。

【时机由我判断。我发信号的时候，站长正处在可靠下属的空档之间。这个窗口很窄。】

en:
He nods as he considers the question.

"Well, originally, First Fleet veterans who refused integration after the armistice. The originals are mostly old now. Their children and the people those children trained are running the operation now."

"They are technically proficient. They have survived in a hostile system on ingenuity and deterrence. They understand that the Alliance cannot absorb them without political consequence." He stops there. "But this operation isn't about petty revenge. Besides, their lives will be better under Alliance Control..."

He trails off on the last sentence, clearly not sold on his own words. But he catches himself.

"The important bit is they are proficient but underfunded fighters, Commander."

他点头斟酌这个问题。

【这个嘛，最初是停战后拒绝融入的第一舰队老兵。第一批人如今大多老了。现在操盘的是他们的子女，和那些子女带出来的徒弟。】

【他们技术上很过硬。他们靠机智与威慑在一个敌对的星系里活了下来。他们明白，同盟吸收他们必然带来政治后果。】他到此为止。【但这次行动不是为了泄私愤的复仇。再说，在同盟治下他们的日子会更好过……】

最后一句他没说完，显然连自己都没被说服。但他收住了。

【关键在于，他们是过硬但缺钱的战斗人员，指挥官。】

en: "Clean operation. Precise. However, don't mistake that for a compliment without conditions."

en: "The casualty count is significant." He does not minimize it. "But Ring-Port is held. That was the objective, good job."

en: "Ring-Port is secured. The count is filed." A pause. "We have what we came for."
zh: 【环港已巩固。伤亡数已归档。】一停。【我们拿到了要拿的东西。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=XLII_AugustDebriefOpening)

en: "I heard there were civilian causalities in the lower decks." A pause as he leans back, static darting across his figure, as he makes a movement that can only be considered smoking. "This is an issue Korrin will have to fix. He has had worse. But he will carry it regardless. This does, however, reflect poorly on all of us."
zh: 【我听说下层甲板有平民伤亡。】一停，他向后靠去，静电掠过他的身影，他做了个只能被形容为抽烟的动作。【这是 Korrin 必须收拾的问题。他经历过更糟的。但这笔账他会一直背着。不过，这事让我们所有人脸上都不好看。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=XLII_AugustDebriefContent)

en: "The inner sanctum's surrender was formal - observed, documented, clean under the Transit Accords." A pause. "That was the outcome I was hoping for."
zh: 【内殿的投降是正式的——有见证、有记录、按转运公约干净利落。】一停。【那正是我希望的结果。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=XLII_AugustDebriefContent)

en: "No prisoners from the inner sanctum. I knew some of them, personally, they were not going to surrender to a foreign commission. Not after twenty years of spitting in my face. I had accounted for the possibility. Clean work."
zh: 【内殿没有俘虏。他们中有些我私下认识，他们不会向一份外国雇佣协议投降。尤其在朝我脸上啐了二十年之后。这种可能性我早有预案。干净利落。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=XLII_AugustDebriefContent)

en: "The inner sanctum's veterans - most of them - are in custody. That is workable. Less clean than a formal surrender. Korrin will manage the transition regardless."
zh: 【内殿的老兵——大部分——已收押。这可以运作。不如正式投降干净。但无论如何，Korrin 会管好过渡。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=XLII_AugustDebriefContent)

【那地方对他有私人意义；所以他去了，但这不是重点。他会没事的，指挥官。】

他的话音淡出，表情里什么都没有。声音里也没有。

en:
"Then I suppose Alliance owes you a debt that predates the paperwork." A beat. "I had an operation planned for that station. Months of preparation. You have made it unnecessary."

You detect the hint of frustration, however faint as he keys something on his console.

"Some credits and a marker of trust. For your 'initiate'..."
zh:
【那么同盟欠你一笔比文书更早的债。】一拍。【我为那座站筹划过一次行动。几个月的准备。你让它变得多余了。】

他在控制台上敲着什么，你察觉出一丝挫折感，无论多么微弱。

【一些信用点，外加一份信任标记。给你这个‘发起人’……】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=DialogOptionSelected)

en:
"Noted." The distorted figure makes a gesture that might be acknowledgment. "The Alliance benefits regardless of who held the blade."

He keys something on the console.

"A small transfer. For services rendered to the Alliance - whether you intended them or not."
zh:
【知道了。】失真的身影做了个可能是致意的动作。【无论持刀者是谁，同盟都受益。】

他在控制台上敲了些什么。

【一笔小额转账。为同盟得到的服务买单——无论你是否有意为之。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=DialogOptionSelected)

en:
The line is quiet for a few brief seconds. When he speaks, the modulated voice carries something that might be controlled anger, might be exhaustion.

"Ring-Port has changed hands." A pause. "Not through the channels I arranged. Not through my terms. Not through any of the infrastructure my people spent months embedding in that station."
zh:
线路安静了几秒。他开口时，调制过的声音里带着某种可能是克制的愤怒、可能是疲惫的东西。

【环港易手了。】一停。【不是通过我安排的渠道。不是按我的条件。也没有经过我的人花了几个月嵌进那座站的任何一套基建。】
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=DialogOptionSelected)

en:
He leans back. The encryption ripples.

"The Office arrived to a situation already in motion. My contingent was not in position. The embedded personnel - Loss. The operational security we built - compromised." He does not raise his voice.

"I do not question the outcome. Ring-Port is out of hostile hands. But the operation I designed was not about the station, Commander. It was about who controlled the transition. That window is closed."

He keys something on the console. The gesture is clipped.

"Credits. The contract rate for the outcome, absent the method. Take it. Consider the matter closed."
zh:
他向后靠去。加密画面荡起涟漪。

【情报局赶到时，局面已在推进。我的分队没有就位。嵌入人员——损失。我们建立的行动安全——失守。】他没有提高音量。

【我不质疑结果。环港脱离了敌对之手。但我设计的行动不只关乎那座站，指挥官。它关乎谁控制过渡。那个窗口已经关上了。】

他在控制台上敲了些什么。动作干脆利落。

【信用点。按结果结算的合同价，不含手法。拿着。此事就此了结。】

en:
"There is one thing." A brief pause that, for once, doesn't feel like a tactic. "Something the Alliance needs - not just for the war effort. But for what comes after it.

Kori's yards can produce hulls well enough. But what we cannot produce - not yet - is the precision manufacturing infrastructure we lost during the civil war. A Pristine Nanoforge. Domain-era. Undamaged.

If you come across one, bring it to me directly." The encrypted silhouette leans forward slightly. "I won't ask where you found it. You won't need to ask what we intend to do with it."

A brief pause.

"The Alliance does not forget its debts, Commander."
zh:
【有一件事。】一次简短的停顿，难得地不像战术。【同盟需要的东西——不只为了战争。为了战后。

Kori 的船厂造舰体绰绰有余。但我们造不出——暂时造不出——内战期间失去的精密制造基建。一台完好纳米锻造厂。域国时代。无损。

如果你碰到一台，直接带给我。】加密的剪影微微前倾。【我不会问你从哪找到的。你也不必问我们打算拿它做什么。】

短暂一停。

【同盟不会忘记自己的债务，指挥官。】

Keep doing what you're doing. That conversation will happen when the time is right."
zh:
【你为我们效力得够好了，指挥官——这没有疑问。】一段克制的停顿。【但有些事，我只为给过同盟更……全面之忠诚证明的人保留。

继续做你正在做的事。时机到了，那场对话自然会来。】

en:
The silhouette on the screen is still for a long moment.

"Some things are better kept off the record. But thank you, truly."

You hear something being keyed in the background.

"The forge goes to Kori. What it produces will outlast both of us." A pause - the first one that doesn't feel calculated. "I have something for you, in return. A part of what the Alliance Intelligence Office has held since end of the war."

Data streams to your command console - encrypted manifests, operational assessments, a transfer authorization bearing August's personal cipher.

"Octantis, or at least a uplink to it. I've been advised not to speculate - but it will serve your fleet well. I have it on authority that it performs." A brief silence before the connection modulates.

"Needless to say, do not lose it, Commander. We try to avoid giving these out freely."
zh:
屏幕上的剪影静了很长一刻。

【有些事最好不留记录。但谢谢你，真心的。】

你听见背景里敲击键盘的声音。

【锻造厂去 Kori。它的产出会比我们俩都活得久。】一停——第一次不像算计出来的停顿。【我有东西回赠你。同盟情报局自战争结束以来持有的一部分。】

数据流向你的指挥控制台——加密清单、行动评估、一份带着 August 个人密码的转移授权。

【Octantis，至少是它的一条上行链路。有人建议我别去猜测——但它会好好伺候你的舰队。我有权威渠道保证它的表现。】调制转换前的一小段寂静。

【不必说，别弄丢它，指挥官。我们尽量不随便发放这种东西。】

en:
Stellar Array Alpha, first of the three stations spaced evenly around this orbit, each of them holding its face to Fafnir.

Edge-on it does not exist. Your sensor officer finds it by the hole it leaves in the starfield - a band of absent light eleven kilometres across and, by the return, no thicker than a few hundred molecules.

It keeps its angle as you close. Nothing in the motion suggests machinery.
zh:
星辉阵列阿尔法，三座均布在这条轨道上的空间站之首，每一座都以正脸朝着 Fafnir。

侧对着你时它并不存在。你的传感器军官靠它在星野上留下的空洞找到它——一条十一公里宽的缺失光带，而按回波算，厚度不超过几百个分子。

你靠近时它保持着角度。运动中没有任何东西像机械。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=OpenInteractionDialog)

en:
Stellar Array Bravo rides the same orbit as Alpha and Charlie, a third of the way around the star from each of them, on the same unwavering bearing.

Eleven kilometres of foil, and no way onto it. No docking collar, no berthing spar, no service gantry, no hatch on any surface your scopes can resolve.

Whatever built this array did not expect anyone to come back to it.
zh:
星辉阵列布拉沃，与阿尔法和查理同轨运行，与它们各相距三分之一圈，方位同样纹丝不动。

十一公里的箔片，却无路可上。没有对接环，没有停泊桁，没有维修栈桥，任何你的雷达能解析的表面上都没有舱门。

建造这座阵列的东西，没指望过有谁会回来。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=OpenInteractionDialog)

en:
Stellar Array Charlie holds the last of the three stations on this orbit, identical to Alpha and Bravo in every dimension your instruments can measure.

It takes your sensor officer several minutes to say what is wrong with the returns, because the problem is not something present in them.

The hull is clean. Not maintained - clean. Thirty cycles of war in this system, and the surface reads as though nothing has ever been near it.
zh:
星辉阵列查理，据守这条轨道上三座站的最后一座，在你的仪器能测量的每一维上都与阿尔法和布拉沃毫无二致。

你的传感器军官花了几分钟才说出回波的问题所在，因为毛病不在回波里有什么，而在没有什么。

舰体是干净的。不是维护过的干净——是从未脏过。本星系三十个周期的战争，而它的表面读数就像从未有任何东西靠近过。

en:
Your team spends four hours on the collector spine. Your Ops Chief reads the returns twice before speaking.

"It's not a reflector, $PlayerSirOrMadam. There's no focal assembly, and there's nothing downrange to reflect onto. It's aimed at the star, and the star is the only thing it has ever been aimed at."

They set the slate down.

"And it's drawing. I can't tell you from what. Thermal's dead, no plasma tap, no corona intercept - it isn't a shunt, before you ask, I checked that first. But the collection budget on this one array runs to eleven figures and I've nowhere to put the decimal."

A pause.

"Historians called these mirrors. Whoever wrote that never came out here."
zh:
你的小队在集光主脊上花了四个小时。运作长把回波读了两遍才开口。

【它不是反射镜，$PlayerSirOrMadam。没有聚焦组件，下游也没有任何供反射的落点。它对着恒星，而且它从来只对着恒星。】

他们放下板岩。

en:
Six hours on the spine and your team finds no way inside. What they find instead is a housekeeping channel, unencrypted, broadcasting to nobody.

"Alignment log, $PlayerSirOrMadam. It corrects itself. Sub-arcsecond, continuous, and it has been doing it without interruption for as far back as the buffer runs."

Your Ops Chief scrolls, and keeps scrolling.

"Last correction was fourteen minutes ago."

A beat.

"There's no crew. Nothing seems to have docked here since the end of their war. I had the Sustainment archive queried on the way out - there is no maintenance contract for these arrays, there has never been a maintenance contract for these arrays, and Acquisitions has a form for that. It's the one you file when the asset does not require servicing."
zh:
在主脊上六个小时，你的小队没有找到进去的路。他们找到的是一条例保频道，未加密，向空无一人广播。

【对准日志，$PlayerSirOrMadam。它在自我校正。亚角秒级，连续不断，而且从缓冲区能追溯的最早记录开始就没中断过。】

你的运作长滚动着记录，一直滚。

【上一次校正是十四分钟前。】

一拍。

【没有船员。他们的战争结束之后，似乎没有任何东西在这里对接过。出来的路上我查了维持局的档案——这些阵列没有维护合同，从来没有过维护合同，而采办局为此专门有一种表格。就是你在一个资产不需要维护时填的那种。】

en:
Your team walks the full face and reports no impact scarring. No micrometeorite pitting. No weapons burns.

"The Gate took a beating and the Gate wasn't even a target, $PlayerSirOrMadam. This thing sat through the entire war."

Your Ops Chief has the fleet archive open.

"Athebyne's bombardment groups transited inside weapons range of this array on eleven recorded occasions. Nobody fired. Not a warning shot, not a ranging round. It isn't on anyone's target list, and I can't find the order that took it off."

They hesitate over the last of it.

"One more thing. Whatever this array does, it doesn't do it at a constant rate. The housekeeping buffer keeps the peaks - it ramps when something downrange calls for it, and holds until whatever that is has had its fill. The longest on record runs seventy-two hours."

Nobody on the bridge asks which seventy-two hours.
zh:
你的小队走完了整面阵列，报告没有撞击疤痕。没有微陨石麻点。没有武器灼痕。

【星门挨了顿揍，而星门甚至不是目标，$PlayerSirOrMadam。这东西坐完了整场战争。】

你的运作长开着舰队档案。

【有记录可查的，Athebyne 的轰炸群十一次从这座阵列的武器射程内经过。没人开火。不是警告射，不是试射。它不在任何人的目标清单上，而我找不到把它移出去的那道命令。】

最后一段他们迟疑了一下。

【还有一件事。这座阵列无论做什么，都不是按恒定速率做的。例保缓冲区留着峰值——下游有什么召唤时它就爬升，然后保持到那个东西吃饱为止。记录里最长的一次持续了七十二小时。】

舰桥上没有人问是哪七十二小时。

The voice is unhurried, and slightly bored.

"Vessel at close station on the collector array. You are logged. Survey activity in this orbit is prohibited under standing instruction - reference is not provided. Confirm you are departing."

A pause, exactly as long as courtesy requires.

"Your inquiry is noted."
zh:
通讯台标示出一条进入的呼叫，用的是同盟军频。雷达上没有舰队。没有来处标记。

声音不紧不慢，还带着点倦意。

【靠近集光阵列的船只。你已被记录。本轨道的勘测活动为常设指令所禁止——不提供引据。确认你正在离开。】

一停，不多不少，恰好是礼节所需的长度。

【你的疑问已记录。】

"They don't converge on a planet, $PlayerSirOrMadam. They converge under one."

"The Gate cache had a codeword for whatever's down there."

A pause.

"It didn't mention that the thing needs feeding."

"They don't converge on a planet, $PlayerSirOrMadam. They converge under one."

en:
Your Ops Chief is still working. Something in their posture changes.

"It doesn't balance."

They turn the plot. "Whatever's down there is taking a fraction. A large fraction - but a fraction. You cannot siphon on this scale and not shed the remainder somewhere, and the remainder is the larger number."

"It's been called a hyperspace anomaly since before the Alliance," your sensor officer says. "It's in the pilot notes. There's a defence doctrine built on it."

Nobody finishes the thought aloud.

The Rift is not weather. The Rift is exhaust - and the machinery that makes it has been running, without interruption or supervision, since long before anyone in Fafnir was born.

Which leaves one question, and your Ops Chief has the good sense not to ask it. What becomes of the wall, if the machinery ever stops.
zh:
你的运作长还在算。他们的姿态变了。

【账对不平。】

他们转过图来。【下面那东西只取走了一部分。很大的一部分——但只是一部分。在这种规模上虹吸，不可能不把余量泄到什么地方，而余量是更大的那个数。】

【早在同盟之前它就被叫作超空间异常了，】你的传感器军官说。【航行备注里写着。还有一套围绕它建立的防御教义。】

没有人把那个念头说出口。

裂隙不是天气。裂隙是废气——而制造它的机器，在法夫纳任何一个人出生之前，就已经在无人监督、从不停歇地运转。

于是只剩一个问题，而你的运作长很有分寸，没有问出口：如果那台机器停了，那堵墙会变成什么。
note: 对话/事件显示文本 (可自由口语化); 保留 $变量 (trigger=DialogOptionSelected)

en:
The beacon is old. Domain-pattern casing, pitted grey by cycles of particle wash, its solar collectors long since scoured blind. Its transmitter is not old at all.

The loop is Alliance-issue.

"NAVIGATIONAL HAZARD. Particle flux beyond this marker exceeds survivable tolerance for unshielded hulls. Turn back."

"The Fafnir system is closed to unauthorised traffic by standing order of the Draconis Defence Alliance. Vessels attempting transit without current approach data will be intercepted. Consider this your notification."

Underneath it, on a subcarrier nobody troubled to strip out, the buoy's original signal is still running. Survey-standard, pre-Collapse, patient as anything.

"...unresolved anomaly. Origin unknown. Do not approach. Do not approach. Do not..."

Your comms officer holds the second channel a moment longer than necessary, then closes it.
zh:
信标很老。域国规格的外壳，被无数周期的粒子冲刷出麻点灰，太阳能收集板早已被打瞎。它的发射器却一点也不老。

循环播放的是同盟制式。

【航行危险。此标界之外的粒子通量超出无护盾舰体的耐受极限。请折返。】

【法夫纳星系依德拉科尼斯防卫同盟常设命令，对未授权交通关闭。未持现行进近数据试图跃迁的船只将被拦截。此即通知。】

在它下面，一条没人费心清除的子载波上，浮标最初的信号仍在运行。勘测标准制式，大崩坏之前，耐心得很。

【……未解析异常。来源不明。请勿接近。请勿接近。请勿……】

你的通讯官把第二条频道多留了一瞬，才关掉它。

Auxiliary Inspector arrived at Kori Station six weeks ago with a writ of inspection, a platoon of marines, and the quiet confidence of a man backed by the largest navy in the sector. Fleet Admiral August received him in the command centre, offered him coffee, and told him, politely, that no Hegemony personnel would be setting foot in the refinery complexes.

The cores stayed - The Inspector left. Three days later, a Hegemony Battlegroup translated in-system at the Fafnir jump point.

The formal communication used the term "compliance action." The kind you send when you've already decided how negotiations will end.

August's response was simple: "All ships, this is Admiral. The enemy is at anchor and aware. We will engage now. Batteries released. Open fire."

核心留下了——督察走了。三天后，一支霸主战斗群从 Fafnir 跃迁点跃入星系。

正式通文里用的词是【遵约行动】。那种你已经在心里谈完了谈判结果的通文。
